title: Correct remaining lifecycle, lease, and durability documentation semantics
description:
Resolve the remaining final-review findings on creation state, claim-acquire assignment behavior, lease semantics, atomic replacement versus append logging, expired lease effects, and Gitless document capabilities.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Lifecycle, claiming, lease, and atomic-write descriptions match current command and storage behavior without extending guarantees beyond source.
- [hard] REQ-02: Git requirements distinguish commit/history operations from filesystem-backed document operations.
- [hard] REQ-03: Scoped mechanical documentation checks and repository validation pass.
